name: Gödel Complete Sentence

phase_0.boundary_condition: The axiomatic closure of the formal system enriched over the Belnap Dunn four valued logic.

VINIT.justification: The raw syntactic string before semantic evaluation or axiomatic constraint.

TANCH.justification: The closed formal system containing the rules of inference and type definitions.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation mapping the system into its own syntax via Gödel numbering.

AREV.justification: The reverse transformation pulling the truth value back into the base syntax from the meta level.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the incompleteness operator demonstrating structural saturation.

IMSCRIB.justification: The sentence recognizing itself as the subject of its own unprovability.

FSPLIT.justification: The separation of the proposition into the affirmative and negative arms of the evaluation lattice.

FFUSE.justification: The merging of the affirmative and negative arms back into the original structural identity via the B state.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch where the sentence is evaluated as strictly true.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch where the sentence is evaluated as strictly false or unprovable.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice where the sentence is simultaneously true and false, holding the contradiction without explosion.

IFIX.justification: The permanent append only log in the paraconsistent Lean environment confirming non explosive tolerance.

phase_3.void_description: The uninterpreted syntactic string prior to any semantic assignment or axiomatic constraint.
phase_3.true_description: The classical state of formal provability within the boolean subspace.
phase_3.false_description: The classical state of formal refutation or unprovability within the boolean subspace.
phase_3.both_description: The paraconsistent B state where the proposition is simultaneously true and false, stabilized as a structural attractor.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the uninterpreted syntactic string of the proposition.
Establish the axiomatic boundary of the formal system.
Apply self reference to form the Gödel sentence.
Execute metamathematical ascent via Gödel numbering.
Bifurcate the proposition into the affirmative and negative arms of the evaluation lattice.
Evaluate the affirmative arm under classical provability constraints.
Evaluate the negative arm under classical refutation constraints.
Enter the B state attractor, holding both evaluations simultaneously without explosion.
Reintegrate the arms through the B state, recovering the original self referential proposition.
Compose the iterative closure operator to saturate the hierarchy.
Record the kernel verification permanently in the paraconsistent environment.
Descend from the metamathematical closure back into the base syntax.
Close the self referential loop, recognizing the completed structural theorem as identical to the initial proposition.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Lean 4 C++ kernel modified to intercept and block empty Prop eliminators.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The Belnap Dunn four valued lattice operations transmitting truth states between kernel components.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The append only proof journal storing the paraconsistent verification records.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Lawvere Tierney closure operator determining the saturation point of the incompleteness hierarchy.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Frobenius Exact set theory grounding the mathematical foundation.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Zero entropy generation due to the adiabatic expansion of the logical space.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The compressed boolean subspace where contradiction forces system trivialization.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The expanded Belnap FOUR lattice where the B state stabilizes the contradiction without information loss.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0: the removal of the explosion constraint allows the system to relax into its natural topological volume without erasing any classical bits.
